scripts.gen:types:
openapi-typescript src/openapi.json --output src/api.d.ts && python -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('src/api.d.ts'); text=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'); text=text.split('*/', 1)[1].lstrip(); p.write_text('/**
 * Generated, do not edit. Regenerate with npm.cmd --prefix web run gen:types
 */

' + text, encoding='utf-8', newline='
')"
